title: Show fallback remux route badge
summary: Completed route chips now distinguish backend-reported oversized encode remux fallback rows with a split encode/remux badge.
reason: A completed row whose encode exceeded size policy and then published a remux fallback previously looked identical to an ordinary remux row.
behavior_before: All Completed remux rows rendered the same green REMUX route chip, even when route evidence said encode was attempted first and remux fallback was published.
behavior_after: Completed remux rows with oversized_encode_remux_fallback evidence render a split blue-left/green-right REMUX chip with a tooltip explaining the encode-to-remux fallback.

rollback_plan: Revert the completed route-chip category helper, remove the remux-fallback CSS rule, and remove the focused WebView assertions added for the split badge.
